'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Harpster LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Harpster]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: WHT (V). Transcription note: sheet Name "HARPSTER" only

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' ^ ^
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
